newsitem.title: USA: Best Products to sell all store assets.
newsitem.headline: Best Products to sell all store assets.

text.p: Best Products Co Inc said on Thursday that it has agreed to sell substantially all of its retail store-related assets for about $395 million, including proceeds from a deal earlier this week.

A combination of Schottenstein Bernstein Capital Group, LLC and Alco Capital Group Inc are offering to buy the assets in a deal that could help bring Best Products out of Chapter 11 bankruptcy, Best Products said. The company had agreed to sell 81 of its stores earlier this week.
Best Products said the sales agreement is subject to the completion of the investment groups' due diligence and approval by the U.S. Bankruptcy Court, the company said.

If a final agreement is approved, the transaction would be completed before Thanksgiving and Schottenstein Bernstein and Alco would acquire and continue to operate Best Products' remaining 88 Best stores and 11 Best Jewelry stores, said the company, which presently operates 169 Best stores.
The investment groups would also offer employment to a substantial number of Best Products' employees, Best Products said.
